Canon plugin support

What it does

Canon keeps project context in a local database you choose and lets your assistant search and read it, scoped to one workspace and project.

Try it

  • Check that the Canon context store is healthy.
  • Search Canon for decisions about the release checklist.
  • Show the full Canon record behind the first search result.

Before you install

Plugin name: canon-local. Runtime: Python 3.11 or newer. The full install steps are in the plugin README.

Get help

Questions and problem reports: github.com/HarperZ9/canon/issues.

From the privacy policy: Support and security reports: https://github.com/HarperZ9/canon/issues
